description: How many 80 lb bags of stucco you need for a wall: base coat (scratch and brown) bags from the manufacturer's coverage at your system thickness, plus finish coat bags. Formula: Area = (wall − openings) × (1 + waste). Base bags = area ÷ coverage, where coverage per 80 lb bag = 20–24 sq ft × (3/8 in ÷ base thickness). Finish bags = area ÷ (70 sq ft × 1/8 in ÷ finish thickness).

openings_sqft.description: Windows and doors to subtract (sq ft); default 100
